title: Honest Bands for Synthetic Survival Control under Low-Rank Factor Structure
gap_reasons: requested strength-indexed decaying-Gram frontier/adaptive result is a new research program and not a bounded in-scope repair
proof_attempt_summary: The run completed a mathematically accepted 43-page discovery proof of the rank-normalized SSC band construction and minimax bounds; all 24 proof records were discharged, all six citations were verified, and the final math and decision reviews passed. The cold general review assessed the result at field tier rather than the required flagship tier; reaching flagship would require a new decay-indexed Gram frontier and adaptive-band or impossibility theory.
tldr: The project studies the missing post-control survival trajectory for a treated unit in a right-censored exact-factor panel. The canonical target coordinate follows from target-pre factor compatibility and is unique because the pre-period contrast Gram is positive. Exact rank one eliminates target-loading uncertainty and gives \(W_1^*\asymp(N_0K_D)^{-1/2}\). For every fixed \(r\ge2\), the unrestricted result is the honest bracket \(c\rho_r\le W_r^*\le C\{\rho_r+\eta_D(K_D)\}\); it reduces to \(W_r^*\asymp\rho_r\) only when \(\eta_D(K_D)=O(\rho_r)\), and no unrestricted tightness is claimed. A censoring-aware patient-level functional-PCR martingale-multiplier band supplies the upper envelope, with a fixed-margin treatment of its hard regular/fallback switch and a singular-covariance-safe random quantile. Without a uniform positive pre-period Gram, minimax honest width is of order one even on a donor-visible known-rank-two subclass. This is a generic information-theoretic boundary: donor-rank visibility alone does not imply a shrinking or rank-adaptive honest band.
gap: Han and Shah establish identification and finite-grid consistency for Synthetic Survival Control but do not provide uniformly honest continuous-time bands, patient-level propagation through PCR, or a minimax converse; their PETAL interval resamples donors only.
fill: The project derives canonical coordinates from an exact-rank, bounded-spectrum donor operator, defines minimax width over bands constrained at each evaluated sample triple, obtains an arbitrary-relative-growth functional expansion and attaining multiplier band, and supplies matching lower bounds including an explicit rank-two target-loading pair.
